facts.fact: Feminin Actu reports that on 6 February 2026 the digital transition minister said a fund for digital inclusion of vulnerable groups had been set up and announced adapted kits for persons with disabilities and AI sign-language translation.

BFA.note: The document states no citizen feedback channel.
It gives only a gap in internet use among persons with disabilities, no share of the population using the internet.
Maisons des citoyens are only envisaged for residents; no local government office connection is stated.
The document states no figure for schools with internet or a compulsory curriculum.
